structural_change: STW-S81e-COLLA2 10-23 FALLBACK (K16 roots, as r7km): successor of s81hd_tile_r7km for the COORD tile review (OK; E-face pin regs p90 151 um). Measured on the r7kf 3_5_place_dp: 430 of 565 E outputs had their launch flop > 50 um from the pin (up to 342 um); io_flop_at_pins anchored only 53 outputs ('515 ports not single-flop') because yosys opt_merge merged the E-face x pass-through register xo_q[511:0] with the bundle's first x line stage (same D x_q) -> the INV after the merged flop drove both the port BUF and u_b.u_x line, GPL pulled it to the bundle. Fix: opt-in OT_S81HD_XO_KEPT = xo_q in a keep_hierarchy cell ot_s81hd_xo512 (same D, same edge, port its only load) -> anchored at the E face by io_flop_at_pins (face fence). 0 cycles, ports/outline/pins/clocking unchanged. Prior: STW-S81c-HEAD-TILE 10-22 successor of r6km (FAIL 03:15) on the same R6 RTL 22a89b512 and geometry (648 = H10 reserve), regional k-means clock roots kept. Measured cause of ALL four R6-RTL gates (r6m/r6f/r6km/r6kf): 3_3_place_gp timing-driven repair RSZ-3006 (ODB-1211: native fp32 adder cells are dont_touch, GPL stretched a native net and could not buffer before its dont_touch load), so CTS never ran and the >15k/root clock_domain item had no measured spread (FAIL).
